<subject>EWEB Inquiry</subject>
<body>
EDWARD:

A follow-up question regarding EWEB:

EWEB requests that the definition of "Applicable Rate" remains unchanged and does not switch to the Non-default Rate if the payee is the defaulting party. They emphasize the need to maintain a "balanced rate." Please advise. 

Kind regards,  
Sara  
</body>
